description: This file defines the 'drain' package for Kubernetes, including the Helper struct and methods to manage draining nodes by deleting or evicting pods, supporting eviction API, filtering pods, and waiting for pod deletion.

classes.name: Helper
classes.description: Contains parameters and methods to control node draining, including pod eviction and deletion, with support for eviction API and filtering.

methods.name: CheckEvictionSupport
methods.description: Checks if the Kubernetes server supports the eviction subresource API.

methods.name: makeDeleteOptions
methods.description: Creates delete options for pod deletion, considering grace period and dry run.

methods.name: EvictPod
methods.description: Evicts a specified pod using the appropriate eviction API version.

methods.name: GetPodsForDeletion
methods.description: Lists pods on a node matching selector for deletion, applying filters.

methods.name: DeleteOrEvictPods
methods.description: Deletes or evicts a list of pods, preferring eviction if supported.

methods.name: evictPods
methods.description: Evicts multiple pods concurrently with retries and wait logic.

methods.name: deletePods
methods.description: Deletes multiple pods and waits for their termination.

methods.name: waitForDelete
methods.description: Waits until specified pods are deleted or evicted.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the context associated with the Helper, or a background context if nil.
